scope.goal: Delete the exact production strategies with Enabled=false in the verified preview, together with all exclusively attributable structured bet history, preserving every other strategy and its history.
inScope: Production PostgreSQL 192.168.0.101:5432/polycopytrader only. Freeze the 276 UUID/code identities observed at 2026-09-15T19:26:29.563872Z; independently rechecked sorted UUID comma-join MD5 293def10788fe14d05af1b908ac97d49. Every target must still exist with the exact code and Enabled=false immediately before its writes; a changed target set or ownership conflict stops execution before further writes.

All own structured Paper/Live/dry-run order history, fills, strategy-market runs, signals, positions, settlements, skip archives and rollups, shadow records, attributable accounting audit and fee-backfill events, and derived strategy performance/projection data/queues. Ownership must be proved by exact strategy UUID, verified strategy:Code wallet, or enforced source-row dependency; shared rows must not be deleted.

Initial sequential preview across the exact276 targets:681106 Paper orders,681106 fills,919822 raw strategy-market runs,681106 own-wallet signals,681091 positions with0open,681091 settlements,824828 archive-v1 rows,0archive-v2 rows and16802 rollups. These are core history counts, not a claim of complete auxiliary-table coverage. Fresh full per-table counts, exclusive signal/order ownership, active-state checks, dependent-row allowlists, trigger/FK/index checks and current health are mandatory before the first mutation. An incomplete preflight does not authorize partial blind deletion.

Use one task-specific PowerShell/SQL script, not a generic cleanup system. Serial execution one target strategy at a time: first one complete financial chain as a canary, then short independently atomic batches of at most 100 complete own financial chains; residual own history in batches of at most 1000 rows; final deletion one strategy at a time only after its complete dependency graph is empty. Smaller batches are allowed when measured latency requires them; larger batches or different mechanisms require new approval.

Each financial batch must preserve complete own-source accounting-chain consistency and cannot delete a source still referenced by a retained row. Reuse only existing wallet/advisory and projection-worker coordination where the inspected implementation requires it. Keep constraints and triggers enabled; no broad table lock. Use statement_timeout at most15s and lock_timeout at most1s for mutations; failed batches roll back. A single whole-operation transaction is forbidden.

Before and between batches verify service Running, heartbeat age<=180s, last_error=NULL, unchanged expected process/version, no waiting DB locks, expected affected counts and task invariants. On degradation, ownership conflict, unknown commit or unexpected affected counts stop before the next batch, reconcile exact journal against remaining DB state, and report completed/remaining scope. Never restart or fix the service to make cleanup proceed.

Maintain a minimal durable per-batch progress journal in the task report with target IDs, committed row counts, UTC timestamps and reconciliation evidence, not a data backup. Each next batch is independently idempotent and resume derives only from the frozen allowlist, journal and current remaining rows.

User-requested deletion is irreversible for successfully committed batches: no backup/dump/clone or archival copy is created. A transaction rollback protects only its current uncommitted batch. Existing external backups are not assumed available.

Estimate: several hours for the observed history volume and gentle batch limits; actual duration remains unverified until the canary. Report measured throughput and revised ETA before the full run. Time alone is not a stop condition, but new scope/resources/risk/method require separate approval.

Preserve all enabled strategies, including their Child/LowerEnter identities and own history, compiled catalogs, original source data shared across strategies, and all trading settings. Current independent preview found no target references in 397041 Child assignment rows and no target LossDiff states; recheck before apply.
